result.keyword: How to pass Wise business account address verification for a newly registered UK company?
result.markdown:
Passing address verification for a newly registered UK limited company on Wise Business requires clear alignment between what you enter in your profile and the official documents you submit.[wise.com](https://wise.com/gb/blog/wise-business-account-requirements-uk#:~:text=To%20reduce%20delays%3A%20*%20Use%20clear%20scans,your%20business%20activity%20is%20supported%20before%20applying.) 

Wise splits business verification into two different types of addresses—your **Registered Address** (where your company is officially registered with Companies House) and your **Trading Address** (where you physically operate day-to-day).[wise.com](https://wise.com/gb/blog/how-to-get-limited-company-verified-using-wise-business#:~:text=You%20will%20need%20both%20the%20registered%20address,clear%20details%20and%20an%20appropriate%20issue%20date.) 

---

### Step 1: Understand the Difference Between Your Addresses
* **Registered Address:** This is usually pulled automatically from Companies House (e.g., your accountant's address or a registered office provider). Because it's a government record, Wise verifies this automatically through official registries, though they may occasionally ask for incorporation documents.
* **Trading Address:** This is where you actually work (which can be a home office, a physical shop, a co-working space, or the same as your registered address). **Crucial rule:** Wise **does not** accept PO Boxes, mail-forwarding services, virtual offices, or solicitor/agent addresses as a trading address. 

### Step 2: Gather Acceptable Proof of Trading Address
If Wise asks you to verify your trading address, they will require a high-quality photo or PDF of a document matching your **business name (or business owner's name)** and your **exact trading address**.[wise.com](https://wise.com/help/articles/2969315/how-does-wise-verify-my-business-address#:~:text=What%20documents%20do%20you%20accept%20for%20my,must%20be%20less%20than%2012%20months%20old.) 

Depending on how new your company is, acceptable documents include:
* **A UK Bank or Credit Card Statement:** Statements from traditional banks or authorized business/neobanks (such as Monzo Business, Starling, or Revolut Business).[wise.com](https://wise.com/help/articles/2969315/how-does-wise-verify-my-business-address#:~:text=%7C%20%7C%20Bank%20or%20credit%20card%20statement,tax%20authority%20%28like%20HMRC%20or%20the%20IRS%29.) *(Note: Personal bank statements showing your home address work if you operate out of a home office and use that as the trading address).*
* **HMRC Correspondence / Tax Documents:** Official letters from HMRC (e.g., relating to Corporation Tax registration, PAYE, or VAT) sent to your business or trading location.[wise.com](https://wise.com/help/articles/2969315/how-does-wise-verify-my-business-address#:~:text=%7C%20%7C%20Bank%20or%20credit%20card%20statement,tax%20authority%20%28like%20HMRC%20or%20the%20IRS%29.)
* **Utility or Broadband Bill:** Gas, electricity, landline, or broadband bills issued within the last 3 months.[wise.com](https://wise.com/help/articles/2969315/how-does-wise-verify-my-business-address#:~:text=What%20documents%20do%20you%20accept%20for%20my,must%20be%20less%20than%2012%20months%20old.) *(Mobile phone bills are rejected).*[wise.com](https://wise.com/help/articles/2969315/how-does-wise-verify-my-business-address#:~:text=We%20can't%20accept%20mobile%20phone%20bills.%20%7C,%7C%20Must%20be%20an%20official%20government-issued%20document.)
* **Commercial Lease or Rental Agreement:** Signed by both you and the landlord.[wise.com](https://wise.com/help/articles/2969315/how-does-wise-verify-my-business-address#:~:text=*%20The%20document%20must%20be%20in%20PDF%2C,signed%20by%20both%20you%20and%20the%20landlord.)
* **Business Insurance Policy:** Professional indemnity, public liability, or commercial property insurance.[wise.com](https://wise.com/help/articles/2969315/how-does-wise-verify-my-business-address#:~:text=%7C%20%7C%20Business%20licence%20or%20registration%20document,an%20official%20council%20bill%20or%20notification.%20%7C)

### Step 3: Avoid Common Reasons for Rejection
Newly registered companies often face delays due to minor mismatches. Ensure you avoid these common pitfalls:
* **Virtual Office / Mail Forwarding Red Flags:** If your trading address points to a known virtual office provider or mail drop (even if legal for Companies House), Wise's automated and manual compliance checks will flag it. Use your actual physical operating location (like a home office or commercial studio).[wise.com](https://wise.com/gb/blog/how-to-get-limited-company-verified-using-wise-business#:~:text=You%20will%20need%20both%20the%20registered%20address,clear%20details%20and%20an%20appropriate%20issue%20date.)
* **Document Age:** Utility bills and bank statements must be less than **3 months old**; tax documents or insurance policies must be less than **12 months old**.[wise.com](https://wise.com/help/articles/2969315/how-does-wise-verify-my-business-address#:~:text=We%20need%20a%20high-quality%20photo%20or%20PDF,be%20in%20PDF%2C%20JPEG%2C%20or%20PNG%20format.)
* **Data Mismatches:** Ensure the spelling of the company name, company number, and the exact formatting of the address match word-for-word between your Wise account settings and the uploaded document.[wise.com](https://wise.com/help/articles/2969315/how-does-wise-verify-my-business-address#:~:text=The%20document%20has%20an%20SSN%20on%20it.,in%20a%20PDF%2C%20JPEG%2C%20or%20PNG%20format.)
* **File Formats:** Upload clear, uncropped PDFs or high-resolution JPEGs/PNGs. Do not upload photos taken of a computer screen.[wise.com](https://wise.com/help/articles/2949804/how-do-i-verify-my-address#:~:text=We%20may%20also%20need%20the%20back%20of,do%20not%20accept%20photos%20taken%20of%20screens.)

### Step 4: How to Submit
1. Log into your Wise account on the web or mobile app.
2. Navigate to **Business Details**.[wise.com](https://wise.com/help/articles/2969315/how-does-wise-verify-my-business-address#:~:text=*%20Select%20Business%20details.%20*%20Under%20Trading,new%20document%20ready%2C%20and%20we%20can%20help.)
3. Check your **Trading Address** field to ensure it is accurate. 
4. If prompted to upload documents via an email notification or the dashboard verification tab, upload the file directly through the secure upload prompt.[wise.com](https://wise.com/gb/blog/wise-business-account-requirements-uk#:~:text=If%20documents%20are%20requested%2C%20you'll%20receive%20an,Centre%20guidance%20on%20uploading%20a%20verification%20document.) Reviews typically take up to 2 working days.

* **Utility or Broadband Bill:** Gas, electricity, landline, or broadband bills issued within the last 3 months. *(Mobile phone bills are rejected).*
* **Commercial Lease or Rental Agreement:** Signed by both you and the landlord.
* **Business Insurance Policy:** Professional indemnity, public liability, or commercial property insurance.

Newly registered companies often face delays due to minor mismatches. Ensure you avoid these common pitfalls:
* **Virtual Office / Mail Forwarding Red Flags:** If your trading address points to a known virtual office provider or mail drop (even if legal for Companies House), Wise's automated and manual compliance checks will flag it.
